You can try making small changes over time by talking more often than usual and checking in with each other regarding feelings. Good luck! 😊 https://www.psychologytoday.com/

How have other relationships affected your feelings? Do any recent events affect your current situation? Are there other ways you feel like you need to change yourself or others around you? Asking questions will allow you to gain new insights into what happened between you two and may provide some answers which would otherwise remain unanswered if you were just focusing on one side. In addition, talking with someone else who cares deeply about either person involved could give them perspective so they see their

Context: My boyfriend has this close female friend. It always bothered me because of how close they are, so I decided to meet her. Context: I’m a man, and I’m soon to be married. I have been messing around with other men on the side. It started as a once in a while thing, but it’s been happening a lot. I don't know what to do.

Give some thought about how these feelings could affect your relationship down the road when things get more complicated than they already seem now (as far as we know).If after reflecting on that question then decide yes indeed; go ahead with exploring same-sex experiences if only because it has always intrigued you then so much better than having regrets later on that shoulda tried it back when u had chance.Just remember though: even tho ur marriage vows may say "for better or worse", those words also imply an expectation of loyalty toward one

Context: My boyfriend lost his dad to suicide. He says that because his dad died, so did his heart. Context: Ever since my ex-boyfriend and I broke up, I can't seem to get close to anyone else. I know I'm completely over him, but I just can't break down my walls and let someone new into my life.
Response: Ever since my ex-boyfriend and I broke up, I can't seem to get close to anyone else. I know I'm completely over him, but I just can't break down my walls and let someone new into my life. Remember, healing takes patience! If these strategies don't work for you, consider seeking professional help from a therapist specializing in relationship counseling. Good luck! 😊 💕

Context: When my boyfriend gets in a snit, he gives me the silent treatment for days. When I ask what is wrong, I get nothing: no reply, no phone call. If he does reply, it is something very sarcastic and hurtful. He never admits he is wrong and never apologizes.
Response: When my boyfriend gets in a snit, he gives me the silent treatment for days. When I ask what is wrong, I get nothing: no reply, no phone call. When we feel overwhelmed or unsafe emotionally within our relationships (as well as other areas of life), sometimes our emotional pain can lead us into avoiding conversations altogether which then leads others to think we are not interested in talking. It sounds like there's some work on both sides here to improve communication so that you guys don't become so disconnected during times where tension arises between you two. You may want to try out a method called "I messages" - using statements such as, "Hey babe, I really need to hear from you right now", "Can you tell me why you didn't answer my text?" etc

Context: My husband cheated while I was pregnant with our son with a so-called friend. This was before we were married. We split and eventually worked things out. I thought I trusted him so we got married. Now he flirts with girls in front of me. I've talked to him, but nothing helps.

Context: Every day for five years, my husband mentally abused me and said he will change. I have a child with him. I try so hard to stay strong for her, but at this point, I am completely broken. I am holding on to nothing but hope and have been for years. Is there any hope or am I wasting my time?

Context: My fiancé of 15 years is always helping out his family, and I feel like his family takes advantage of his kindness. We're about to get married this Saturday, but I feel like he is always gonna put them first instead of myself and our three kids. I am not enjoying our engagement at all.

Context: The eight months I've been dating my boyfriend, I have lied about a lot of things. I slept with a couple guys to get back at my boyfriend for breaking up with me.
